style: soft 3D cartoon, top-down, warm and friendly
themeWhy: the wholes the child cuts are a roti, a pizza and a chocolate bar: toasted-crust and chocolate-brown keys, a berry-pink Enter as the treat of the same table; never red, never violet

images.object: freshly cooked golden-brown wheat phulka roti
images.why: Description 'a chapati' and the shelf's 'round chapati with toasted spots': the whole roti on the shelf and the amber board, clipped per wedge when the Cut dial cuts it; the same picture clipped unevenly in code is the torn roti; and, drawn small (about 80 across), each thing in phase 4's Group view row of rotis
images.prompt: A freshly cooked whole-wheat phulka roti, a warm golden-tan to light wheat colour, with a soft uneven puffed surface, several dark-brown toasted blister spots and gentle uneven char patches, a slightly irregular round edge, a fine dusting of flour, a soft satin sheen and a hint of ghee gloss. Realistic home-cooked food, richly detailed.

images.why: Description 'a pizza' and the shelf's 'pizza with toppings': the whole pizza on the shelf, the amber board, the blue plate and phase 3's pizza box; clipped per wedge, each wedge keeps its crust on the outer arc
images.prompt: A round pizza with a golden-brown puffy crust rim, melted pale-yellow cheese, a scatter of brown mushrooms and golden pepper rings.

images.object: one square piece of milk chocolate with a raised moulded border, a glossy rich-brown surface and a softly bevelled edge, photographed from above
images.why: the shelf's 'chocolate bar with its squares' and phase 2's bar to cut and lift: one real square of chocolate, drawn once per part (equal widths come from code) so each part reads as a real piece
images.prompt: One single square piece of real milk chocolate in rich dark brown, with a raised moulded border around a slightly recessed panel, a glossy highlight along the bevelled edge, a fine hint of cocoa texture on the surface and softly rounded corners.
